name: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation

page_limit_content.note: 投稿正文（含图、表）上限 12 页；参考文献页不限、另计。2023–2025 规则一致。

evidence.quote: Submitted papers must be no longer than 12 single-spaced 8.5" x 11" pages, including figures and tables, plus as many pages as needed for references, using 10-point type on 12-point (single-spaced) leading, two-column format, Times Roman or a similar font, within a text block 7" wide x 9" deep.

references_counted.note: 参考文献不计入 12 页正文上限（'as many pages as needed for references'）

evidence.quote: including figures and tables, plus as many pages as needed for references

camera_ready_extra_pages.note: 录用稿在 proceedings 中允许 14 页（投稿 12 + 2）；原文 '14 pages in the proceedings, plus references'

evidence.quote: Accepted papers will be allowed 14 pages in the proceedings, plus references.

paper_size.note: USENIX 官方模板要求 U.S. letter 纸（8.5x11in）；模板 documentclass 亦为 letterpaper

Two-column format

margins_mm.note: 等效单边页边距：上下 1in=25.4mm；左右 0.75in=19.05mm（letter 8.5in − 7in 版心 / 2）

evidence.quote: USENIX wants margins of: 0.75" sides, 1" bottom, and 1" top.

anonymity.note: 投稿双盲；自引需第三人称

evidence.quote: The paper review process is double-blind. Authors must make a good-faith effort to anonymize their submissions, and they should not identify themselves or their institutions either explicitly or by implication (e.g., through the references or acknowledgments).

page_numbering.note: 送审稿需加页码；图/表须黑白可读、不需放大

evidence.quote: Pages should be numbered, and figures and tables should be legible in black and white, without requiring magnification.

supplementary_policy.value: optional, in files separate from the submission; PC not required to read
supplementary_policy.note: 补充材料单独文件提交，审稿人无义务阅读，正文须自洽

evidence.quote: Authors may upload supplementary material in files separate from their submissions.

submission_system.note: PDF 经 USENIX 在线投稿系统提交

evidence.quote: Papers must be in PDF format and must be submitted via the submission system

title_format.note: 标题 14pt 粗体、不打印日期（模板注释）

evidence.quote: Usenix titles are in 14-point bold type

abstract_max_words.note: 官方模板建议摘要不超过 200 词（尽量接近 150）

evidence.quote: Not more than 200 words, if possible, and preferably closer to 150.

float_placement_rules.value: floats usually placed where LaTeX prefers (tbp)
float_placement_rules.note: 模板正文：浮动体通常交给 LaTeX 决定位置

evidence.quote: Floats should usually be placed where latex wants then.

color_policy.value: color allowed, but figures/tables must remain legible in black and white
color_policy.note: 图/表须在黑白打印下可读

evidence.quote: figures and tables should be legible in black and white, without requiring magnification

caption_style_hint.value: text inside figures should be at least as large as the caption text
caption_style_hint.note: 模板正文对图内字号的要求

evidence.quote: Text size inside figure should be as big as caption's text.

open_questions: USENIX 未明文规定图题/表题位置（在图上/表上），模板 sty 亦未强制，故 figure_caption_position/table_caption_position 未写。
USENIX 官方页未给页边距数值（仅模板 sty 注释 0.75in sides + 1in top/bottom），标为 template-implied。
camera-ready 的 14 页是否含 references 未 100% 明确（原文 '14 pages in the proceedings, plus references'）。
是否允许独立技术附录（appendix）无明文，仅 'supplementary material in files separate from your submission'。
abstract 200 词为模板建议（template_default），非 CFP 硬性拒稿条件。
submission system 名称（USENIX 在线系统，底层常见 HotCRP）未在 CFP 明确。
